title: Dracula
author: Bram Stoker
summary: Told through letters, journals and newspaper clippings, a young solicitor travels to a Transylvanian castle and discovers his client is not human. The Count then follows to England, where a band of friends sets out to stop him.
readIf: you want the original vampire novel and enjoy an old-fashioned gothic story told in documents.
skipIf: you want a fast, modern horror pace, because Victorian prose and some slow stretches are part of the deal.

pairings.reason: A modern, emotional retelling of what it is like to be a vampire.
Another Victorian-era gothic classic about a monster and the ethics of creating or confronting it.
A modern, scholarly novel that follows the Dracula legend through libraries and old cities.
